faq.q: What is the origin of Jumadi?
faq.a: Jumadi is associated with Arabic. Jumadi is Arabic جُمَادَى (Jumādā), a month of the Islamic calendar. The source gloss 'Follower of the moon' is unsupported and has been replaced with the documented identification.
Yes — the underlying form جمادى is Arabic.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Jumadi, jumadi. Script forms are جمادى, جمادی, जुमादा.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
